blocks.html: Ducts shall be made tight with lap joints having a minimum lap of 1 inch (25.4 mm). Joints used in SMACNA/ANSI Round Industrial Duct Construction Standards and SMACNA/ANSI Rectangular Industrial Duct Construction Standards are also acceptable.
